question: Which of the following is NOT included in the domain of Psychological Well-Being?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pollution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Psychological Well-Being (PWB)** is a multi-dimensional concept that refers to the **internal state** of a person, including their cognitive and emotional evaluations of their life as a whole.
 
• **Sense of purpose** is a core domain of psychological well-being as it provides **meaning** and a feeling that one's life has a **direction** and **goals**. *Hence, this is a part of the domain.*
 
• **Optimism** reflects a **positive outlook** and the expectation of good outcomes in the future, which is fundamental to **resilience** and emotional stability. *Hence, this is a part of the domain.*
 
• **Pollution** is an **external environmental factor** that belongs to the study of **Environmental Science** or **Public Health**; while it can negatively affect mental health, it is not an intrinsic psychological domain. *Hence, statement 3 is the correct choice as it is NOT included in the domain.*
 
• **Feeling of accomplishment** (or Achievement) is the satisfaction derived from **reaching milestones** or succeeding in tasks, which is a key pillar in psychological frameworks like the **PERMA model**. *Hence, this is a part of the domain.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Carol Ryff’s Six-Factor Model**: Developed in **1989**, this model is one of the most scientifically validated frameworks for measuring **Psychological Well-Being**. It includes **Self-acceptance**, **Personal growth**, **Purpose in life**, **Environmental mastery**, **Autonomy**, and **Positive relations with others**.
 
• **The PERMA Model**: Introduced by **Martin Seligman** (the founder of **Positive Psychology**) in his **2011** book *Flourish*, it outlines five elements of well-being: **Positive Emotion**, **Engagement**, **Relationships**, **Meaning**, and **Accomplishment**.
 
• **Subjective Well-Being (SWB) vs. PWB**: **Subjective Well-Being** (often termed **Hedonic** well-being) focuses on **happiness** and the balance of pleasure over pain, whereas **Psychological Well-Being** (**Eudaimonic** well-being) focuses on **human potential** and living a meaningful life.
 
• **Environmental Determinants**: While **Pollution** (including **air**, **noise**, and **water** pollution) is a significant **determinant** of mental health outcomes such as **Anxiety** or **Depression**, it is classified as a **stressor** or a **contextual factor** rather than a psychological domain itself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **World Health Organization (WHO) Definition**: The **WHO** defines health as a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity. This highlights that **Well-Being** is a proactive state.
 
• **Biological Factors**: Psychological well-being is often linked to the regulation of **neurotransmitters** such as **Serotonin**, **Dopamine**, and **Oxytocin**, which facilitate feelings of **reward**, **social bonding**, and **happiness**.
 
• **Demographic Influences**: Factors like **age** (well-being often follows a **U-shaped curve** across the lifespan), **socio-economic status**, and **cultural context** can influence how different domains like **autonomy** or **achievement** are prioritized by an individual.
 
• **Impact of Climate Change**: Modern psychological studies now recognize **Eco-anxiety**, which is the chronic fear of environmental doom caused by **Pollution** and **Climate Change**, further distinguishing the external cause from the internal psychological state.
